version: cdc_child (edition year not stated in section)
title: Childhood poliovirus (IPV) 4-dose series complete by age 7
action: Administer IPV doses to complete the routine 4-dose series by age 7.

derived.min: final dose is due at 4-6 years, so by age 7 the series is expected to be complete
derived.max: single-year cohort at age 7 so the check is not applied to older persons who may assume prior vaccination

derived.window: a child aged 7 on Dec 31 of MY was born in calendar year MY-7, so the window covers all doses since birth
